title: The Agentic Company OS: Substrate Inversion for Sustained Enterprise Agent Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2609.13334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise AI agents often succeed in a demonstration and then stall once they must operate day after day. An industry report estimates that most pilots never reach production and that deployed systems rarely retain feedback or improve over time, while agent benchmarks show single-run successes masking unreliable repetition. We argue that these failure modes share a common architectural root: agents reason over data structured for human operators and traditional applications, not for the language models that power them. This position paper proposes that companies deploying agents in sustained operation should rebuild their cognitive substrate, the shared environment agents read as working context, around representations matched to that reasoning surface, isolating schema translation to the action boundary. Markdown is the instantiation available today, not a proven agent-native primitive. Two mechanisms ground the argument: context-ban

translated_title: 智能体企业操作系统：面向企业级智能体持续部署的基底重构
translated_abstract: 企业级AI智能体往往在演示中取得成功，但一旦需要日复一日地持续运行就会停滞不前。一份行业报告估计，大多数试点项目从未进入生产环境，且已部署的系统很少保留反馈或随时间改进，而智能体基准测试显示，单次运行的成功掩盖了不可靠的重复表现。我们认为，这些失败模式存在一个共同的架构根源：智能体推理所基于的数据是为人类操作员和传统应用程序结构化的，而不是为驱动它们的语言模型设计的。本立场论文提出，在持续运行中部署智能体的企业应围绕与该推理表面相匹配的表示形式来重建其认知基底（即智能体作为工作上下文读取的共享环境），并将模式转换隔离到动作边界。Markdown是当前可用的实例化方式，而非经过验证的智能体原生原语。两个机制为该论点提供了支撑：上下文禁……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出，企业AI智能体持续部署失败的根本原因在于其认知基底是为人类而非语言模型设计的，因此企业应围绕匹配语言模型推理需求的表示形式重建认知基底，以实现智能体的长期稳定运行。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that enterprise AI agents fail in sustained deployment because their cognitive substrate is structured for humans rather than language models, and proposes rebuilding this substrate around representations matched to model reasoning to enable long-term agent operation.
